title: Malicious code in @nuxzofficial/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package @nuxzofficial/baileys contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise potentially allows an attacker full control over the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of the compromise, simply removing the package may not eliminate all malicious software. All secrets and keys stored on the compromised computer should be rotated immediately from a separate, secure device.
